课程简介（中文）

本课程旨在提供对西班牙语国家的全面概览。课程将深入探讨拉丁美洲、西班牙以及其他西班牙语国家和地区的文化、历史、社会和饮食等多方面的多样性与核心要素。学生将分析西班牙语的演变历程，以及它在四大洲之间作为全球纽带所发挥的作用。

本课程向所有对西班牙语世界研究（Hispanic studies）感兴趣的学生开放。

课程简介（英文）

This course provides a comprehensive perspective of Spanish-speaking countries. It explores the diversity of cultures, history, societies, and gastronomy, among other key aspects of nations in Latin America, Spain, and other regions and countries where Spanish is spoken. Students will analyse the evolution of the Spanish language and its role as a global connector across four continents. 

This course is open to all students with an interest in Hispanic studies.

Basic proficiency in Spanish is recommended but not required, as lectures are conducted in English or, where the environment permits, in Chinese.

教学目标

Upon successful completion of this course, students will be able to:

  • Identify the key historical periods of the Spanish-speaking world.
  • Explain the demographic and economic impact of the Spanish language globally.
  • Analyse the cultural differences and shared identities among Hispanic societies.

教学方式

The course utilizes a multidisciplinary approach, incorporating multimedia resources and interactive discussions focused on the historical and contemporary influence of the Spanish-speaking world.

教学内容与进度安排

16 weeks (2 sessions per week).

Week 1. Introduction to the Spanish-speaking world. The history of Spanish language and his diversity.

Week 2. Spain (España).

Week 3. Introduction of South America and Argentina

Week 4. Bolivia and Chile

Week 5. Colombia and Ecuador

Week 6. Paraguay and Perú

Week 7. Uruguay and Venezuela

Week 8. Introduction of Central America and The Caribbean.  Costa Rica

Week 9. Cuba and El Salvador

Week 10. Guatemala and Honduras

Week 11. Nicaragua and Panamá

Week 12.  Puerto Rico and República Dominicana

Week 13. North America: México

Week 14. Africa: Guinea Equatorial

Week 15. Spanish-speaking in other countries I: Andorra and Filipinas

Week 16. Spanish-speaking in other countries II: Belice and United States of America
